heading:
Prove what you made.
Keep what's yours.
lead: Almost every image, PDF, or video you export - PNG, JPG, APNG, GIF, SVG, TIFF, WebP, PDF, MP4 and WebM - can carry a **Content Credential** - a tamper-evident [C2PA](https://c2pa.org) seal made and signed right where you work. It proves the file hasn't changed since it left Lolly, and once you enrol an identity, records who signed it. Rasters also carry the invisible **Lolly Imprint** in the pixels themselves, on by default, so a copy can still be recognised even after the credential is stripped.

checks.title: Tamper-evident by default
checks.desc: The seal covers every exported byte. Change one pixel and any C2PA validator flags it.

checks.title: Signed with a key only you hold
checks.desc: Your signing key is generated locally and stays where it was made - not even Lolly can read it.

checks.title: Verify anything, yourself
checks.desc: The Verify tab checks a file's credential, flags AI-generated content, reads the Lolly Imprint and surfaces hidden data.

cards.title: Scrub and lock
cards.desc: Strip Hidden Data removes EXIF and metadata locally. Lock a PDF, a download, or a share link with a password only you hold.

cards.title: Self-host or air-gap
cards.desc: No backend in the core render path - no database, no server-side processing to operate. Run it entirely behind your own firewall; the optional server add-ons can be omitted.
